args.title: Update error toasts to use assertive aria-live and persist without auto-dismiss
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the Toast component and/or ToastProvider so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" (or role="alert") and do not automatically dismiss after five seconds, ensuring critical errors are announced properly and remain visible to users.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/components/Toast.tsx sets aria-live="polite" on the toast stack and auto-dismisses every toast after 5000ms regardless of kind. Update Toast component and/or ToastProvider so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" (or role="alert") and do not automatically dismiss after five seconds.
